Maya (AE): Heads up: LedgerSafe asked for a 4-week pilot. Use case: contract discovery + clause extraction + automated redaction. They emphasized single-pass on long docs and an SSO/HSM requirement.
Ethan (SE): Quick questions: peak QPS, doc size distribution, and must-have acceptance metrics?
Maya (AE): They said spikes up to 150 QPS, avg doc ~9k tokens, but ~10% of corpus has "monster" contracts ~60-120k tokens. Acceptance: extraction F1 >= 0.88, search recall >= 0.82, interactive latency < 800ms p95.
Priya (ML Eng): Two technical approaches: (1) chunk+dense-embed+rerank (cost-efficient), (2) long-context model (>=100k) for single-shot. For the latter we need Private or Dedicated due to data residency and KMS.
Jules (Security): They require BYO-HSM or approved KMS, audit logs for every inference, and cipher-suite list. Also need SOC2 + penetration test report.
Ethan (SE): For chunking plan: 6k token chunks w/1k overlap -> embed -> top-300 retrieve -> rerank with 32k model. We'll use prefix caching for frequent queries.
Maya (AE): Budget constraint: pilot must be <= $10k/month. Can we propose hosted pilot within that?
Priya (ML Eng): Hosted chunking + quantized embedding store should fit. Long-context Private route likely exceeds budget. We can show both options in SOW.
Ethan (SE): Practical detail: 5M docs -> if chunks avg 2 per doc -> ~10M chunks. Embedding dim 1536; with int8 PQ storage we can fit under ~20GB for the index. Need to confirm memory on sandbox cluster.
Maya (AE): They also want a demo of tool-calling to an internal signer and a redaction step before model sees PII. Any blockers?
Priya (ML Eng): We can insert a pre-processing function call that redacts, then call the model. Tool-calling supports sync calls and webhooks. Example: 
```
POST /redact
{"text":"<contract>..."}
```
Ethan (SE): For demo we'll stub signer with a test HSM endpoint. Prod: customer will swap in their HSM keys.
Jules (Security): Please ensure we document key rotation policy and separation of plaintext exposure. I'll need the artifact for KMS integration (flow diagram + cryptographic boundary).
deploy-bot: sandbox cluster reserved: ledger-poc-sandbox (2026-05-02T08:00Z) ticket#7812
Maya (AE): Proposed timeline: week1 ingest + eval capture, week2 run baseline + tune chunk size, week3 scale test + latency tuning, week4 acceptance + knowledge transfer. Is that realistic?
Priya (ML Eng): Reasonable if customer provides labeled eval set Day0. Without it week1 slips.
Maya (AE): I'll request eval set and their security contact today.
Ethan (SE): Draft acceptance criteria for SOW: 
- Functional: clause extraction F1 >= 0.88; search recall >= 0.82 at top-50.
- Performance: retrieve+rerank p95 <= 600ms for typical doc sizes, end-to-end p95 <= 850ms under 150 QPS bursts.
- Security: KMS/HSM integration validated; audit logs available for 90 days; data residency in eu-west1.
Priya (ML Eng): I'll prepare an eval harness (automated runs + metric dashboard) and a short explanation of chunking trade-offs (latency vs recall).
Jules (Security): I'll begin the security questionnaire. Need answers about retention of temporary unredacted artifacts and where logs live. Also confirm if customer can bring HSM to Redwood Private.
Ethan (SE): Private supports customer HSM. Hosted supports envelope encryption with customer-managed keys for payloads at rest, but there are operational differences we must detail.
Maya (AE): Who owns the runbook and demo?
Ethan (SE): I'll own the runbook and the demo playbook. Priya owns the eval harness. Jules will own questionnaire responses.
Maya (AE): Ok. Can everyone review a draft SOW by Wednesday EOD?
Priya (ML Eng): Yep.
Ethan (SE): Yep.
Jules (Security): On it.
Maya (AE): Thanks team :rocket: Ill ping LedgerSafe after collecting their eval set and sec contact.
